items.name: Context
items.summary: Represents information about the current context provided to [`Layer`]s by the wrapped [`Subscriber`].

methods.name: current_span
methods.summary: Returns the wrapped subscriber's view of the current span.

methods.name: enabled
methods.summary: Returns whether the wrapped subscriber would enable the current span.

methods.name: event
methods.summary: Records the provided `event` with the wrapped subscriber.

methods.name: event_scope
methods.signature: fn event_scope(&self, event: &Event<'_>) -> Option<registry::Scope<'_, S>> where S: for<'lookup> LookupSpan<'lookup>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the [stored data] for all the spans in the current context, starting with the parent span of the specified event, and ending with the root of the trace tree and ending with the current span.

methods.name: event_span
methods.signature: fn event_span(&self, event: &Event<'_>) -> Option<SpanRef<'_, S>> where S: for<'lookup> LookupSpan<'lookup>
methods.summary: Returns a [`SpanRef`] for the parent span of the given [`Event`], if it has a parent.

methods.name: exists
methods.signature: fn exists(&self, id: &span::Id) -> bool where S: for<'lookup> LookupSpan<'lookup>
methods.summary: Returns `true` if an active span exists for the given `Id`.

methods.name: lookup_current
methods.signature: fn lookup_current(&self) -> Option<registry::SpanRef<'_, S>> where S: for<'lookup> LookupSpan<'lookup>
methods.summary: Returns [stored data] for the span that the wrapped subscriber considers to be the current.

methods.name: metadata
methods.signature: fn metadata(&self, id: &span::Id) -> Option<&'static Metadata<'static>> where S: for<'lookup> LookupSpan<'lookup>
methods.summary: Returns metadata for the span with the given `id`, if it exists.

methods.name: span
methods.signature: fn span(&self, id: &span::Id) -> Option<registry::SpanRef<'_, S>> where S: for<'lookup> LookupSpan<'lookup>
methods.summary: Returns [stored data] for the span with the given `id`, if it exists.

methods.name: span_scope
methods.signature: fn span_scope(&self, id: &span::Id) -> Option<registry::Scope<'_, S>> where S: for<'lookup> LookupSpan<'lookup>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the [stored data] for all the spans in the current context, starting with the specified span and ending with the root of the trace tree.
